text:
Sam: Hi everyone — first day! quick q: where should I post VPN/access/devbox problems vs hardware/desk requests?
Maya: welcome Sam :tada: VPN/devbox -> #eng-infra. hardware/desk -> #people-ops (file the equipment form). if you need a devbox, ping @infra-bot with `request devbox`.
Sam: perfect. can I mute the noisy deploy bots in channels I follow? worried i'll miss something important.
Maya: you can mute specific bots in channel notifications (click channel name -> Notifications -> Mute @bot). do NOT mute #eng-oncall or #incidents — those are critical.
Sam: cool. also, i work PST — how do i set quiet hours so i don't get pings overnight?
Nathan: go to Preferences -> Notifications -> Do Not Disturb schedule, or use the bot shortcut: in any channel `/quiet-hours set 22:00-07:00 PST`. that will apply to your account.
Sam: thanks. small follow-up: where do people usually post a short intro? #new-hires or #general?
Maya: #new-hires for onboarding-y intros and follow-ups (you'll get buddy intros there). #general if you want a company-wide hello. for team-level intros, drop a note in your team's channel.
Sam: gotcha. any guidelines for intro content?
Maya: keep it short — name, pronouns, team, 1 sentence about what you'll work on, and maybe a fun one-liner (coffee? pets?). example: "Hi — I'm Sam (they/them), joining infra. excited to work on build/reliability and coffee automation." :coffee:
Sam: haha love it. one more: if I see a deploy bot spam after I join, what's the recommended action?
Maya: react with :eyes: if it's relevant, file a quick thread reply asking ops to quiet non-actionable noise, and if it's recurrent open a ticket with #eng-infra. ops prefers threads not DMs so others see context.
DevOncallBot: Incident #4212 created by monitoring — follow escalation steps in #incidents.
Sam: saw the incident ping. good to know it's routed correctly.
onboarding-buddy: Hi Sam — I sent you the onboarding checklist, calendar invites, and the quickstart doc. DMing now.
Sam: thank you! last thing: are links to docs and bot cheat-sheets pinned anywhere?
Maya: yes — pinned in #new-hires and in #devex. quick links: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/slack-ops and https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/bots. also https://intra.redwood/quickstart/devbox for devbox steps.
Sam: saved all. appreciate the speedy replies :thumbsup:
Maya: welcome aboard again — ping any of us if something blocks you.
Sam: will do, thanks everyone!
